GAME_TEXT.paldea_intro: After defeating Leon and claiming the Galar Championship, a mysterious letter arrived — Professor Sada of the Paldea region wrote of ancient Pokémon sightings near the Great Crater. With your mother already purchasing a seaside cottage in Cabo Poco, you set sail for a land of open skies and untamed frontiers.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_departure_from_galar: The memory of Leon's smile as he handed you the Championship Crown stays with you as the ferry carries you south toward Paldea. Eight regions. Eight championships. And ahead — three paths converging on a mystery at the bottom of the world.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_mom_home_cabo_poco: Mom is sitting on the porch of her little seaside cottage. 'Oh, you're here! The prize money from Galar arrived just in time — I put the deposit down the very day you became Champion. The realtor keeps asking why I have homes in so many regions. I told her: my child wins a lot.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_mom_random_1: Mom waves you over enthusiastically. 'I had tea with a retired professor today who asked how I could afford all these homes. I told him about Kanto, Johto, Hoenn, Sinnoh, Unova, Kalos, Alola, and now Galar. He needed to sit down after Kalos.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_mom_random_2: Mom pulls out an enormous ledger. 'Eight regions, eight championship titles, eight homes — give or take. Your father left us one cozy apartment back in Pallet Town. You have added rather a lot since then. I am so proud, and so very comfortable.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_mom_random_3: Mom offers you a plate of empanadas. 'The neighbors in Cabo Poco think I am some sort of eccentric heiress. I let them believe it. It is easier than explaining that my child went off at age ten and became champion of eight different Pokémon regions.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_rival_nemona_intro: A girl with a confident grin blocks your path out of town. 'Hey! You look like you have got what it takes. I am {rival_name} — top student at Naranja Academy and champion-ranked Trainer. Let us battle! Go easy on me? Actually no — please do not. I want you at your best!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_rival_nemona_rematch: {rival_name} is already bouncing on her heels when she sees you at the Academy. 'There you are! I have been training non-stop since our last battle. I finally feel like I can go all out. This is everything I have been building toward. Let us go!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_professor_sada: Professor Sada greets you in dusty field gear, fresh from the Crater. 'The Pokémon in my photos exist. Koraidon — a creature of an ancient age. Miraidon — a being of a future not yet born. I have been building something in Area Zero. Something that will change everything.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_team_star_intro: A convoy of custom-painted vehicles roars past. A red-haired girl leans out the window: 'Back off, twerp! Team Star does not mess with newbies — unless you are asking for it.' She tosses a flyer. TEAM STAR — WE DO WHAT WE WANT.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_team_star_penny: A quiet girl in a Lechonk hoodie bumps into you near the Academy. 'Oh — sorry. I am... nobody important.' She pulls her hood lower. Something about her feels oddly familiar.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_penny_reveal: The quiet girl throws back her hood. 'I am Cassiopeia. I am the boss of Team Star.' She gives a tired smile. 'I did not want it to go this far. Please — help me fix this.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_arven: A tall boy with a worn apron approaches. 'You look strong. I need someone strong. There are Titans — giant Pokémon guarding rare herbs I need. My Pokémon is hurt. Will you help me? I cannot do this alone.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_area_zero_entrance: The Great Crater of Paldea yawns before you — a wound in the earth so deep that different eras bleed through its walls. Paradox Pokémon wander its depths. Somewhere below, a machine hums at a frequency that should not exist.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_paradox_machine: Professor Sada stands before the Paradox Machine. Her expression is terrifyingly calm. 'I knew you would come. I built it to bring more ancient Pokémon into the present. I cannot let you stop it.' She raises a Poké Ball. The crater shakes.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_koraidon_encounter: A mighty Pokémon bursts from the depths — ancient, powerful, its body a living engine of a forgotten age. Koraidon regards you with ancient eyes. For a moment, the whole crater is still.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_miraidon_encounter: A sleek mechanical Pokémon rises from glowing fissures — Miraidon, humming with electromagnetic energy from an age not yet born. It observes you with alien curiosity.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_area_zero_cleared: The Paradox Machine goes dark. The rift closes. Arven kneels by his Mabosstiff, who stirs and opens his eyes. Penny pulls off her hood. {rival_name} runs over, out of breath. The four of you stand in the quiet of the crater. Champions in your own right.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym1_intro: Katy, the Bug-type Gym Leader of Cortondo, waves you in. 'Welcome! Our gym test is rolling a giant olive ball to the goal — while my Nymbles try to stop you. Think you can manage?'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym1_victory: Katy claps. 'Amazing! You have earned the Bug Badge. Paldea's gyms only get tougher from here!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym2_intro: Brassius surveys his city of sculptures. 'Art speaks to the soul. My Pokémon speak with power. Let us see which language you understand.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym2_victory: Brassius stares at his fallen Sudowoodo. 'Verdant rage... Surrenderance.' He hands you the Grass Badge. 'Your battle was a masterpiece.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym3_intro: Iono bursts onto the gym stage in a blaze of camera flashes. 'Iooono-ma! Your number-one Gym Leader! Let us play a little find-my-partner game — livestream is already rolling, so give the fans a SHOW!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym3_victory: Iono bounces on her heels. 'You found my partner AND beat my team? The chat is going WILD! Take the Electric Badge — you earned the clout!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym4_intro: Kofu slaps his broad hands together. 'I am Kofu — chef and Water-type Gym Leader! Before you battle me, you must win a market auction. A chef who cannot compete for ingredients is no chef at all!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym4_victory: Kofu lets out a booming laugh. 'Magnificent! You fought with total conviction. Take the Water Badge!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym5_intro: Larry looks up from his menu with no expression. 'Oh. Another challenger.' He closes it. 'Normal-type Gym Leader. Larry. Let us get this done. I have a late lunch reservation.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym5_victory: Larry accepts his loss with no reaction whatsoever. 'Normal Badge. Here.' He goes back to his menu.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym6_intro: Ryme adjusts her mic stand. 'Yo, welcome to Montenevera! Ghost-types, double battles, bars that will haunt you. Drop the beat!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym6_victory: Ryme nods. 'You kept your cool against my squad. Ghost Badge — it is yours. I might write a song about this.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym7_intro: Tulip examines you carefully. 'Your aura is interesting. My gym test will reveal your inner potential. Whether I like what I see... depends on how you battle.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym7_victory: Tulip gives a rare genuine smile. 'Your potential is real. The Psychic Badge is yours.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym8_intro: Grusha hunches against the cold. 'Was a pro snowboarder before this. Leg injury. Now I am a Gym Leader.' He sighs. 'Let us battle. Try not to make it boring.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_gym8_victory: Grusha almost smiles. 'You are really good. Here — Ice Badge. You remind me of how I used to compete. Do not lose that.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_elite_rika: Rika leans back, arms crossed. 'Ground-type user, Rika. Nice to meet you — briefly. Let us get serious. I want to see what you are made of before you face the top.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_elite_poppy: Poppy bounces excitedly. 'Wow wow wow, you beat Rika! I am Poppy! I use Steel-types! I am going to try super duper hard to stop you — please do not hold back!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_elite_larry2: Larry stands with his arms folded. 'We meet again.' He sighs. 'I joined the Elite Four because the chairman made me. I eat a late lunch between challengers. Come on then.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_elite_hassel: Hassel strikes an artistic pose. 'Challenger! I am Hassel — art teacher, Dragon-type Elite Four member, and humble devotee of beauty in all forms. Allow me to paint you a picture... of defeat!'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_champion_geeta: Geeta turns from the window with an unhurried smile. 'You remind me of myself, years ago. I have never been defeated in this arena. I intend to maintain that record. Show me everything you have.'
GAME_TEXT.paldea_champion_victory: Geeta bows her head. 'Extraordinary. A trainer who has come this far and still burns with that same hunger. You are the Champion of Paldea.' She steps aside, and the arena erupts.
GAME_TEXT.paldea_post_champion: With Paldea's championship won, all three paths complete, and the Paradox Machine dark forever, you sit with Arven, Penny, and {rival_name} under the stars above Area Zero. {rival_name} grabs your arm. 'You are the best rival I have ever had. I am going to catch up — I promise.' You believe her.
paldea_newgame_intro: You and Mom have just moved into a seaside cottage in Cabo Poco.
Tomorrow is your first day at Naranja Academy. Director Clavell is visiting to welcome you!
Mom: Look sharp, {player_name}! The Director is here, and he brought Pokémon!
paldea_clavell_intro: Director Clavell: Welcome to Paldea, {player_name}! I am Clavell, Director of Naranja Academy.
Director Clavell: Every new student receives a partner Pokémon. These three are quite eager to meet you.
Director Clavell: Take your time. Choose the one you feel connected to.
paldea_clavell_starter: Director Clavell: Splendid choice! Your partner seems delighted.
Director Clavell: Your Treasure Hunt begins tomorrow. Explore Paldea and find your own treasure!
paldea_mom_newstart_1: Mom: The ocean breeze here is lovely! I already miss nothing about our old place.
Mom: Your father would be so proud you're starting at the Academy.
paldea_mom_newstart_2: Mom: Every Poké Dollar you win goes in the jar marked 'Champion Fund'!
Mom: Maybe someday we'll buy houses all over the world. Wouldn't that be something?
paldea_mom_newstart_3: Mom: Nemona's family owns a huge estate up the hill. She says you two are rivals now!
Mom: Be nice to her. And beat her anyway. Ha ha!

boss.name: Black Fog
lines: The air turns ice-cold. A black fog pours across the floor...
Two huge eyes open in the dark. A giant Haunter rises: the Black Fog!
Long ago people worshipped it as a god. It feeds on dreams. Don't let it get yours!
won: The Black Fog is too proud to ever be caught.
It Self-Destructs in a burst of black mist... and is gone.
But a cold whisper lingers: it will rise again in another haunted place.

CASSEROYA_LAKE.description: A vast, still lake in northwest Paldea, ringed by cliffs. Dondozo and Tatsugiri rule its waters.

boss.name: Dondozo
lines: Arven: There it is... the False Dragon Titan!
A colossal Dondozo rises from the lake, a Tatsugiri barking orders from its mouth!

Arven: You did it! And look, a Herba Mystica!

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: A New Land, Three Paths
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Arrive in Paldea and visit Naranja Academy in Mesagoza. Meet Professor Sada, your rival Nemona, and the mysterious Arven.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Bug Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Katy in Cortondo. Complete the olive-rolling gym test and defeat her Bug-type team.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Grass Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Brassius in Artazon. Appreciate the art, then battle the gallery's most passionate exhibit.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Electric Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Iono in Levincia. Find her partner and then face her in a battle livestreamed to millions.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Water Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Kofu in Cascarrafa. Win a market auction before the real battle begins.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Normal Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Larry in Medali. Decipher the secret menu item before entering the gym.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Ghost Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Ryme in Montenevera. Face her Ghost-type double battles with rhymes and attitude.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Psychic Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Tulip in Alfornada. Read the signs hidden in the gym's psychic-powered maze.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Victory Road — The Ice Badge
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge Gym Leader Grusha in Glaseado. Reach his peak and prove you can handle the cold.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Champion Road
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge the Elite Four at Naranja Academy — Rika, Poppy, Larry, and Hassel — then face Champion Geeta herself.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Into Area Zero
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Finish all three paths (Victory Road, Path of Legends and Starfall Street), then descend into the Great Crater of Paldea with Arven, Penny and Nemona to find Professor Sada.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Shut Down the Paradox Machine
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Defeat Professor Sada and destroy the machine before the time rift becomes permanent.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Path of Legends — Help Arven
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Help Arven find the five Herba Mystica guarded by Titan Pokémon scattered across Paldea: Stony Cliff, Open Sky, Lurking Steel, Quaking Earth, and False Dragon.

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: Starfall Street — Dismantle Team Star
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Challenge all five Team Star bases: Fire (Mela), Poison (Atticus), Fairy (Ortega), Fighting (Eri), and Dark (Giacomo). Find out who Cassiopeia really is.
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.reward: TM rewards and the truth about Team Star

JOURNAL_MISSIONS.title: The Ruin Legendaries
JOURNAL_MISSIONS.description: Seek out the four Treasures of Ruin sealed across Paldea: Wo-Chien (Grass), Chien-Pao (Ice), Ting-Lu (Dark/Ground), and Chi-Yu (Fire/Dark).
